scope: Selected test-to-scenario links only. An imported passing selection marks its feature partial, never verified. Explicit skip reasons prevent weaker tests from claiming unrelated coverage.

network.duplicate_status.skip_reason: Duplicate status disconnect is useful protocol coverage but has no matching required scenario in this ledger.

network.concurrent_status.skip_reason: Concurrent status requests do not establish packet framing boundaries or multicore gameplay scaling.

block.fill.skip_reason: Successful fill does not establish command-tree coverage, invalid argument handling or permission failures.

block.clone.skip_reason: Successful clone does not establish command-tree coverage, invalid argument handling or permission failures.

block.water_flow.skip_reason: Presence of a water block does not assert its flow level or source conversion.

block.gravity.skip_reason: A single falling sand block does not exercise sand stacks, anvils or obstructed landing.

redstone.lamp.skip_reason: Adjacent lamp activation does not establish indirect power, wire decay or directional output.

redstone.wire.skip_reason: One powered wire does not establish wire decay or directional output.

redstone.piston_push.skip_reason: One-block piston push does not test push limits, sticky retraction or adhesion.

redstone.daylight.skip_reason: Daylight detector activation has no matching required scenario in the current ledger.

data.storage.skip_reason: One storage command does not establish complete command grammar, argument rejection or permissions.

entity.damage.skip_reason: Unarmored generic damage does not test armor, critical hits or attack cooldown.

entity.kill.skip_reason: Command removal is distinct from spawn, unload/reload and natural despawn boundaries.

datapack.function.skip_reason: Explicit function invocation does not establish load/tick tags, scheduled functions or macros.

dimension.nether.skip_reason: Setting a block in the Nether does not establish terrain, travel scaling or hazards.

dimension.end.skip_reason: Setting a block in the End does not establish island or entry-platform generation.

persistence.write.skip_reason: Writing and observing a live block alone does not prove save/reload, palette expansion or empty sections.

lifecycle.clean_shutdown.skip_reason: Exit status alone does not prove player and chunk saving; inspect separate restart observations.

network.inventory_stream.skip_reason: Receiving inventory packets alone does not establish valid clicks or transaction recovery.

network.client_command.skip_reason: A successful client command does not establish command-tree coverage, argument rejection or permission failure.

persistence.unflushed_write.skip_reason: Pre-stop marker placement only; saving is checked after restart.

persistence.shutdown_restart.skip_reason: An unflushed chunk marker persists after stop with autosave disabled; player saves are not covered.

persistence.signal_write.skip_reason: Pre-signal marker placement only; saving is checked after restart.

lifecycle.sigterm_exit.skip_reason: Signal exits cleanly; separate restart check verifies chunk save, player save remains untested.

persistence.signal_restart.skip_reason: SIGTERM retains the unflushed chunk marker; player save remains untested.

command.store_result_false.scenario: execute score store preserves a zero command result

command.store_result_signed.scenario: execute score store preserves a signed command result

command.store_success.scenario: execute score success differs from a zero command result

command.store_failure.scenario: execute score store records nested command failure

command.store_chain.scenario: chained execute score stores preserve both callbacks

command.store_condition.scenario: execute score store preserves prior scores when a conditional branch is empty

persistence.entity_write.skip_reason: Pre-save summon establishes the UUID and health marker; persistence is checked after restart.

persistence.entity_signal_write.skip_reason: Pre-signal health change establishes a live marker; persistence is checked after restart.

command.entity_count.scenario: execute as runs once for each selected entity
